change the instrument and note · 改变乐器和音符

版本 2：用命令行参数来实验声音

Version 2: Using command-line args to experiment with sounds · 《Head First Java》p452

这个版本还是只播放单个音符，但你要用命令行参数来改变乐器和音符。试试传入两个 0 到 127 之间的 int 值。第一个 int 设置乐器；第二个 int 设置要演奏的音符。

import javax.sound.midi.*;
import static javax.sound.midi.ShortMessage.*;

public class MiniMusicCmdLine {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        MiniMusicCmdLine mini = new MiniMusicCmdLine();
        if (args.length < 2) {
            System.out.println("Don't forget the instrument and note args");
        } else {
            int instrument = Integer.parseInt(args[0]);
            int note = Integer.parseInt(args[1]);
            mini.play(instrument, note);
        }
    }

    public void play(int instrument, int note) {
        try {
            Sequencer player = MidiSystem.getSequencer();
            player.open();
            Sequence seq = new Sequence(Sequence.PPQ, 4);
            Track track = seq.createTrack();

            ShortMessage msg1 = new ShortMessage();
            msg1.setMessage(PROGRAM_CHANGE, 1, instrument, 0);
            MidiEvent changeInstrument = new MidiEvent(msg1, 1);
            track.add(changeInstrument);

            ShortMessage msg2 = new ShortMessage();
            msg2.setMessage(NOTE_ON, 1, note, 100);
            MidiEvent noteOn = new MidiEvent(msg2, 1);
            track.add(noteOn);

            ShortMessage msg3 = new ShortMessage();
            msg3.setMessage(NOTE_OFF, 1, note, 100);
            MidiEvent noteOff = new MidiEvent(msg3, 16);
            track.add(noteOff);

            player.setSequence(seq);
            player.start();

        } catch (Exception ex) {
            ex.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

↑ 用两个 0 到 127 之间的 int 参数来运行它。试试这些入门命令：

File Edit Window Help Alternate
%java MiniMusicCmdLine 102 30 %java MiniMusicCmdLine 80 20 %java MiniMusicCmdLine 40 70
